summary_en: Asahi Kasei will cancel 22.86 million treasury shares on October 30, 2026, reducing outstanding shares by 1.67%. The shares were acquired on November 5, 2025.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 16, 2026, Asahi Kasei's Board of Directors resolved to cancel 22,859,400 treasury shares of common stock pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on October 30, 2026. The shares to be cancelled were acquired by a Board resolution on November 5, 2025. The cancellation will reduce the number of outstanding shares from 1,365,751,932 to 1,342,892,532, representing a reduction of 1.7% of pre-cancellation outstanding shares. Following the cancellation, the company will hold 6,120,811 treasury shares, calculated based on treasury stock as of September 30, 2026.
